results.title: NBFC - Italian National Biodiversity Future Center
results.description:
NBFC (National Biodiversity Future Center) is Italy's national research center dedicated to biodiversity, with a strong focus on biodiversity conservation, ecological restoration, and long-term monitoring. It brings together a network of more than 3,000 researchers from public research institutions and universities, complemented by industrial partners, research consortia, and regional and local authorities. Through close collaboration with national parks, protected areas, and Marine Protected Areas (MPAs), NBFC carries out concrete field activities to assess and enhance biodiversity. These activities include monitoring species richness, genetic diversity, and ecosystem components, while implementing restoration and conservation actions aimed at strengthening ecosystem resilience. NBFC hosts a large community of taxonomic experts covering a broad range of plant, animal, fungal, and microbial groups. Their expertise supports the continuous updating of floristic and faunistic inventories, the production of high-quality taxonomic data, and the provision of authoritative information on species distribution and biodiversity status.

The Center also operates an advanced, multi-layered biodiversity data platform that integrates species occurrence records with molecular information (e.g., DNA barcoding and genomic data) and chemical data, including the characterization of secondary metabolites. This integrated infrastructure enables comprehensive biodiversity analyses across multiple levels of biological organization. In addition, NBFC coordinated the national project for the digitization of Italian herbaria during its first funding period and continues to support the national network connecting museums, universities, botanical gardens, and private collections. This ongoing effort contributes to the preservation, integration, and accessibility of Italy's botanical heritage, strengthening biodiversity research and data sharing at both national and international levels.

results.title: Récolnat — Réseau national des collections naturalistes (France)
results.description:
Récolnat is the French research infrastructure dedicated to facilitating access to natural history collections for scientific research. Established in 2013 and included since 2016 in the French Ministry of Higher Education and Research's national roadmap for research infrastructures, Récolnat supports the standardisation, digitisation, and dissemination of collection data while fostering collaboration and expertise across the natural history community.
Its core missions include improving data quality and curation, promoting best practices in collection management, providing cataloguing tools and support to smaller institutions, and contributing to the professionalisation of collection stewardship. Récolnat also operates the national gateway to France’s natural history collections through its online platform (https://recolnat.fr), which serves both as a discovery portal and as a collaborative data production and management tool for the broader community.
As a founding and active member of the Distributed System of Scientific Collections (DiSSCo ERIC), Récolnat serves as the French national node, contributing to the development of a unified European infrastructure for natural science collections.
